description: Chapter scholarship for seniors at NC high schools entering an accredited STEM program; preference to military-connected students.
eligibility_text: Senior at a North Carolina high school entering an accredited STEM program in the fall; preference given to military-connected students; minimum GPA (not yet published); two letters of recommendation; personal statement. The chapter states amounts and deadlines are pending. 2026 cycle (per BizFayetteville, 2026-04-08): high school junior, senior, or current college student at a North Carolina school pursuing STEM, minimum 2.7 GPA; submissions to admin@nc.afceachapters.org by April 20 (extended).
